children: Chile's central bank is expected to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.5% at its next meeting on September 8 and hold it at that level for the next 24 months, a poll of traders released by the bank showed on Thursday.
The traders also estimated consumer prices in the Andean country would increase 0.3% in August and speed up to 0.6% in September, and rise by 3.3% over the next 12 months.
